info.title: Pencil Ready
info.description:
Generate printable math worksheets as PDF, PNG or SVG.

Every endpoint is a `GET` that returns the file directly, so a worksheet
is just a URL: `/api/worksheets/add?digits=3,3&carry=force&seed=42`.

**Conventions**

- All parameters are optional; omitted ones take the per-worksheet default.
- **Ranges** are `N` (exactly N) or `N-M` (inclusive), e.g. `digits=2-4`.
- **Lists** are comma-separated, e.g. `denominators=2,3,4` or
  `digits=3,2` (one entry per operand).
- **Seeds** make output reproducible: the same parameters and `seed`
  produce the same problems. Without a seed, each request is random.
- Problem count and layout are identical on A4 and US Letter.
- Errors return `400` with a plain-text message.

get.description: Multi-digit addition in columns, with control over carrying. `binary=true` renders in base 2.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Output format. Default `pdf`.

parameters.name: seed
parameters.description: Seed for reproducible output. Omit for a random worksheet.

parameters.name: problems
parameters.description: Number of problems. Default depends on the worksheet type.

parameters.name: cols
parameters.description: Columns in the problem grid. Default depends on the worksheet type.

parameters.name: paper
parameters.description:
Paper size. Default `a4`; `letter` is accepted as an alias for
`us-letter`.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Printed language and number notation. Default `us`.

parameters.name: division
parameters.description:
Division layout for long-divide, simple-divide and mean. Default
follows `locale`: `bracket` for `us`, `equation` for `no`.

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description:
Override the operator symbol, as a typst symbol expression
(e.g. `sym.colon`). Default follows `locale`.

parameters.name: solve_first
parameters.description: Render the first problem as a worked example.

parameters.name: include_answers
parameters.description: Append an answer-key page showing just the final answers (PDF only).

parameters.name: debug
parameters.description: Draw debug borders around problem boxes and grid cells.

parameters.name: grid
parameters.description:
Draw a grid in the answer area to keep digits in columns.
Multiply only; other worksheet types ignore it.

parameters.name: student_name
parameters.description: Pre-fill the student name on the header in a handwriting font.

parameters.name: qr
parameters.description:
Print a QR code encoding `share_url` in the bottom-right of every
page. Default false; has no effect without a valid `share_url`.

parameters.name: share_url
parameters.description:
URL encoded by the QR code when `qr=true`. Must start with
`https://pencilready.com/`; other URLs are silently ignored.

parameters.name: digits
parameters.description: Digit count (range) per operand, comma-separated. Default `2,2`.

parameters.name: carry
parameters.description: Carrying constraint. Default `any`.

parameters.name: binary
parameters.description: Render in base 2; `digits` become bit counts. Default false.

parameters.description: Borrowing constraint. Default `any`.

BorrowMode.description: none: no borrows. no-across-zero: borrows allowed, never across a 0 digit. any: unconstrained. force: every problem borrows at least once. ripple: every problem has a borrow chaining through 2+ columns.

CarryMode.description: none: no carries. any: unconstrained. force: every problem carries at least once. ripple: every problem has a carry chaining through 2+ columns.

ConversionGiven.description: fraction, decimal or percent: that form is printed on every problem. any: a third of the page each.

DenominatorRelation.description: same: 3/8 + 1/8. multiple: one denominator divides the other, 1/2 + 1/4. unrelated: neither divides the other, 2/3 + 3/4. any: all of these.

DivisionStyle.description: bracket: `4)852`, quotient on top; simple division as a vertical stack. equation: one line, `852 : 4 = 213`, long-division working written under the dividend.

Locale.description: us: English copy, decimal point, × and ÷. no: Norwegian Bokmål copy, decimal comma, · and :.

MissingSlot.description: Which slot is left blank for the student to fill in.

OutputFormat.description: pdf: printable, any page count. png / svg: single page only; multi-page worksheets and include_answers return 400.

Paper.description: a4 or us-letter (alias: letter). Problem count and layout are identical on both.

InvalidParams.description:
Parameters failed to parse or validate, or the combination can't
produce a worksheet. Body is a one-line, human-readable error.

text/plain.example: digits: bad digit count: invalid digit found in string

WorksheetFile.description:
The rendered worksheet. Media type follows `format`.
`Content-Disposition` is `inline` with a suggested filename.
